title: Kaskade - Electric Daisy Carnival 2010 Los Angeles - Cam-Mix - Synced to Radio Broadcast
description:
Another restored video from the EDC carnival. It is a full set if I remember correctly. The radio broadcast was taken from Sirius XM.

All right reserved by the artists and affiliated companies.

*Huge thanks to the people who were filming it. Sadly I don't remember their usernames anymore, but they might recognize their camerawork. Of course, if anybody has a problem with the videos used in here, please contact me.
